title: Exploratory Testing — Overview
summary: Simultaneous learning, design, and execution: skilled testers explore within a time-boxed charter.
body:
Simultaneous learning, design, and execution: skilled testers explore within a time-boxed charter. Championed by James Bach and Cem Kaner.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Session-Based Testing, Ad-Hoc Testing, Bug Hunting.
